安排工作说明: Prefer smiling idols, then higher bond. Auto duration targets completion before 23:00.
社团活动说明: Automatically request the item with the lowest stock.
每日挑战说明: Choose the closest score gap. Create a team if needed.
支援卡识别说明: Scan support inventory for box.gakumas.cn. Requires Chinese game text.
偶像之路说明: Open the challenge screen in the game before starting.
培育说明: Before starting, configure card lists, drinks and priorities in the sidebar.
使用道具说明: Select the items to use before producing.
培育次数说明: Select ∞ and disable stamina potions to use only current stamina.
手动输入培育次数输入框说明: Enter an integer of at least 1.
启用自动支援卡说明: When disabled, enable the game's plan compatibility filter. The first card is selected.
跳过准备阶段说明: Enable only when resuming an interrupted run.
检测到商店开始接管培育: Take over when the shop appears
试镜难度降低说明: Lower the selected audition difficulty when available.
试镜手动接管说明: Pause at the selected audition for manual play.
扭蛋兑换说明: Spend coins only on selected gacha types.
每日兑换说明: Exchange selected items when currency is available.
DMM点击延迟说明: Delay after fallback clicks, 0–1000 ms. Other buttons and card play are unaffected.
决定一张牌什么时候打，以及同档位里谁先打。: Choose when to play each card and its order within the same tier.
每张卡牌一条规则，普通与强化版本共用。\n未配置卡牌使用原稀有度档位，优先级为:
One rule per card, shared by base and upgraded versions.
Cards without rules keep their rarity tier and priority 50.
各预设独立保存规则与预览手牌 · 保存后应用于实际出牌 · 当前选中预设生效: Each preset stores its own rules and preview hand. Save to apply the active preset.
选择一张卡牌，开始设置它的使用时机与优先级。: Select a card to set its timing and priority.
最多回合不能小于最少回合: Maximum must not be below minimum.
此卡保持原档位。再动属性独立判断。: This card keeps its original tier. Extra play is checked separately.
R → SR → SSR · 提升后与目标档位比较曲线分数；停用规则后恢复原档位: R → SR → SSR · Compare priorities in the promoted tier. Disabling restores the original tier.
拖动节点，或在下方输入数值。50 为默认值，100 最先，0 最后。: Drag points or enter values below. Default 50; 100 first, 0 last.
节点外沿用最近值 · 阴影区间暂不允许使用: Outside the points, use the nearest value. Shaded turns are blocked.
先满足使用时机，再比较同档优先级。: Timing first, then priority within the tier.
选择 1–5 张牌，可重复。完全同分时按槽位先后排序。: Choose 1–5 cards; duplicates allowed. Ties follow slot order.
从左至右出牌：使用时机 → 再动 → 排序档位 → 曲线分数 → 手牌槽位顺序。: Play left to right: timing → extra play → tier → priority → slot.
当前预设还没有规则，可从下方卡牌库选牌。: No rules yet. Choose a card below.
从下方卡牌库拖入名单；黑白名单互斥，替换名单独立；当前预设修改后立即保存。: Drag cards into a list. Block and allow lists are exclusive; replacement is independent. Changes save immediately.
设置想要的饮料，以及每一种饮料的使用时机。: Choose desired drinks and when to use each one.
最后一回合，使用全部剩余饮料: Use remaining drinks on the last turn
未触发指定条件的饮料也会使用，避免因漏识别而错过时机。: Also use drinks whose conditions did not trigger.
首回合出牌前使用: Use before playing on turn one
没有匹配的饮料，请更换关键词或筛选条件。: No matching drinks. Change the search or filters.
修改后立即保存；战斗中修改将在下一次战斗动作生效。: Changes save immediately and apply to the next battle action.
已保存；目标状态用于获取饮料，使用时机在下一次战斗动作生效。: Saved. Acquisition and timing settings are ready.
尚未选择目标；至少选择一张牌。: Select at least one target card.
目标配置无法读取，请重新选择。: Cannot read targets. Please select again.
原目标配置无法读取，请重新选择后保存。: Cannot read saved targets. Select again and save.
至少选择一张目标卡。: Select at least one target card.
目标条件无效：R / SR 绿豆最多 2，SSR 最多 1。: Invalid conditions: R/SR allow up to 2 customizations; SSR up to 1.
请重新选择目标：回忆卡和卡组后4格不允许 LR、角色卡或支援卡；前2格仅限对应来: Reselect targets: memory cards and the last 4 deck slots exclude LR, idol and support cards. The first 2 slots require the matching source.
只需填写需要的卡；同一份回忆包含全部已选目标才算达标。第1格为角色卡，第2格为支: Fill only needed slots. One memory must contain all selected targets. Slot 1: idol; 2: support; remaining 4: deck cards.
可添加多个目标，逐轮收集，全部保存后停止培育。每张卡分别设置强化和绿豆下限。: Collect multiple targets across runs. Stop after saving all targets. Set upgrade and customization requirements per card.
保留优先级：目标卡＋钻石词条 ＞ 目标卡 ＞ 非目标卡＋钻石词条。已完成目标再次: Keep priority: target + diamond > target > other + diamond. Keep repeat targets with diamonds; progress survives restarts.
读取失败，原文件保留：{0}: Could not load; original file retained: {0}
搜索日文卡牌名称，例如：届いて！、せのびの魔法: Search Japanese card names, e.g. 届いて！
自定义歌曲名称说明: Enter the song name shown in the game. Use Japanese for the original/DMM version and Chinese for the translated version. The idol comes from the selected card list.
自定义歌曲名称输入框说明: Enter a non-empty song name on one line.
自定义歌曲推荐效果说明: This field currently does not affect card selection, play order or event selection.
再生成回忆说明: Use a regeneration ticket at most once per run. Prefer a diamond ability, then more customization points on the obtainable card, then extra action and rarity. Keep the original on a tie. Continue without regeneration if tickets run out; never spend jewels.
启用自动自定义说明: Customize cards in order in HIF interval shops and special guidance. HIF handles two cards per batch, buys current target drinks, then refreshes. Special guidance never refreshes.
普通商店删牌说明: HIF regular shops only. Off by default to save points; event card removal is unchanged.
出牌后额外等待说明: Extra wait once the next hand is stable after playing a card. Default: 1.5 seconds; range: 0–5. Setting 0 removes only this extra wait; animation and hand stability checks remain. Applies to Initial, NIA, HIF and Idol Road.
出牌后额外等待输入提示: Enter 0–5 seconds with up to two decimal places, such as 0, 0.5 or 1.5.
快速命中模式说明: On by default. Exchange the first eligible N, blacklisted, or unprotected R card without scanning further pages. Whitelist and last single-copy cards remain protected. Turn off to compare the deck. Deletion always compares priorities.
